text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page triggered for high-rate-limit errors on /v1/generate from multiple tenants — PD INC-87921. Summary: sudden spike in 429s originating from quota-mapper service in us-west-2. auto-page: critical :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Assigned to oncall_jen (level: primary). Escalation in 8m if unacked.

oncall_jen: ack'd. I'm on it, jumping in. pinging @sre_elaine and @infra_matt for quota-mapper and rate-limiter context.

sre_elaine: seeing a sharp rise in throttles + throttle-mapper logs showing `tag_lookup_timeout` for ~20% of requests. Could be cache backend failing.

infra_matt: checking kvstore (etcd/redis). redis-cluster-usw2 reports increased RTO and 5xx on master. Running `redis-cli -h redis-usw2-01 INFO` now.

oncall_jen: timeline: 12:04 sudden uptick, 12:06 first pager. Which tenants impacted? support_nora, do we have customer-facing alerts?

support_nora: support queue getting 5x messages for 429s, mostly from two customers on Dedicated. Posting sample error from customer: `{"error":"quota_exceeded","detail":"quota-mapper returned deny for tenant:acct-42"}`

infra_matt: redis latency spike correlates with 12:02-12:10 window. Suspect the quota-mapper uses prefix cache in redis, when redis RTOs the mapper falls back to conservative deny path -> misapplied quota.

product_kyle: Can we confirm whether this is config rollout-related? We had a small quota-mapper release yesterday.

sre_elaine: quick grep on deploys: no recent deploys to quota-mapper since 23:00 yesterday. Config push flagged? Checking configstore.

oncall_jen: For immediate mitigation, two options: 1) disable strict-deny fallback in quota-mapper, 2) fail open for specific tenant group. Prefer 1 for broader relief. Any objections? :thinking_face:

infra_matt: I can flip the feature flag in cfg-store. Command: `kubectl -n infra exec cm-patcher -- patch-config --service quota-mapper --set deny_on_cache_miss=false` — will prepare patch and run canary on one node.

product_kyle: +1 for flipping; need to track risk to cost/abuse but this is impacting paying customers.

oncall_jen: go for it. infra_matt, please run and confirm. Also set a short TTL on cache keys to avoid stampedes after recovery.

infra_matt: running patch...

incident-bot: System log: `12:08:14 quota-mapper: resolving cache miss -> response=deny (deny_on_cache_miss=true)`

infra_matt: patch applied to canary quota-mapper pod qm-canary-2. Rolling out to 3/8 pods.

pagerduty-bot: Note: PD INC-87921 updated: mitigation in progress by oncall_jen.

sre_elaine: observing 429 rate drop on canary traffic now — sample graph: `canary 429s: 120 -> 8 within 2m`. Good sign.

support_nora: customers reporting partial recovery, still intermittent for a few routes. Keeping external comms ready.

oncall_jen: rolling to remaining pods. infra_matt: please do a staged rollout, 2 pods at a time, wait 60s between steps.

infra_matt: rolling... applied to 6/8 pods.

incident-bot: Automated metric alert resolved: quota-mapper-429s returned to baseline. PD escalation timer cancelled.

oncall_jen: OK looks stable. Next: follow-up tasks — root cause is redis latency causing quota-mapper to default to deny. Actions: (A) revert deny_on_cache_miss default to true? No, keep fail-open for now; (B) investigate redis cluster health and upgrade config; (C) add retries with jitter in quota-mapper when cache miss due to transient RTOs; (D) add metric for `deny_on_cache_miss` hits.

product_kyle: logging ask: please capture sample trace where tenant acct-42 got wrongly denied for the period 12:02-12:10. We'll need that for customer post-incident note.

infra_matt: redis cluster shows a GC pause on node redis-usw2-03 around 12:01, causing replication lag and leader failover. Opening infra ticket INFRA-2199.

sre_elaine: adding runbook note: if redis RTO -> do not default to deny. We need safer fallback. I'll file SRE-505 to add a circuit breaker and graceful degrade path.

support_nora: drafted customer message: "We've identified an intermittent quota enforcement issue that caused brief 429 errors. Mitigation applied, service restored. We'll share root cause and timeline soon." Want review from kyle before send.

product_kyle: LGTM. Add note: "If you experienced denied requests, please contact support with request IDs."

oncall_jen: PD incident owner: oncall_jen. Handoff: my shift ends in 45m; I'll create a handoff note in the PD incident and ping next oncall.

oncall_jen: handoff summary -> stable, mitigation: disable deny_on_cache_miss, rolling patch completed at 12:12, afterwards 429s back to baseline by 12:15. Root cause suspected: redis GC pause + failover. Open tickets: INFRA-2199 (redis investigation), SRE-505 (mapper fallback redesign), ENG-3337 (add metrics/logging).

oncall_jen: tagging next oncall: @sre_elaine you'll take the PD incident for longer-term remediation?

sre_elaine: taking it. I'll coordinate with infra_matt to dig into GC cause and repair.

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-87921 acknowledged by sre_elaine. Escalations cleared.

support_nora: posting customer note now, cc kyle.

incident-bot: thread closed for now, automated follow-up reminders set for 24h and 72h for postmortem and RCA.

oncall_jen: quick commands used for mitigation (for postmortem):
```
# flip feature flag
kubectl -n infra exec cm-patcher -- patch-config --service quota-mapper --set deny_on_cache_miss=false
# verify pods
kubectl -n services rollout status deployment/quota-mapper
# sample logs
kubectl -n services logs qm-canary-2 | grep "deny_on_cache_miss"
```

sre_elaine: noted. I'll gather logs/traces and create the RCA draft. Thanks everyone. :heart:

support_nora: closing loop with customers once RCA ready.

oncall_jen: final: incident duration ~12:02-12:15 (mitigated), PD open 12:06-12:20 (handoff/confirm). Marking severity: SEV2 (customer-impacting but mitigation available).

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-87921 status: monitoring.

incident-bot: automated note: if any unresolved tasks, add to PD INC-87921 or linked tickets.
